top_signals.title: Iran war depleted US Patriot missile stockpiles, creating readiness challenges, experts say
top_signals.summary: The U.S. has depleted roughly two-thirds of its pre-war Patriot missile interceptor inventory during the conflict with Iran, new analysis says.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Key Areas Where Water Scarcity Intensifies Risks of Conflict
top_signals.summary:
Water disputes can directly drive conflict, but more often, water scarcity acts as a catalyst — one that, combined with other pressures, raises the risk of conflict. This is nothing new; water has shaped human conflict for millennia. What’s changed is the accumulation of stress, as climate change, population growth, human migration, and the intensive demands of agriculture and industry are converging to strain water systems in ways that threaten to exacerbate instability. top_signals.title: Mortgage Rates In US Rise to 6.66%, Highest Level In A Year
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Michael McKee joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield" to discuss the Fed decision, the surge in long-end US Treasury yields and its effect on rates for consumers.  US mortgage rates rose to a 12-month high due to climbing yields. (Source: Bloomberg)
